secretName.description: The NAME of a secret, delivered as `secrets.source` says: `valkey/password`, `issuer/state-secret`. A value is never in the document.

url.description: An http or https URL with a host and no credentials: a password in a URL is a secret in the file, and a secret is named, never carried.

description: The configuration of `sluis backup`, the backup module (docs/decisions/0071): a scheduled export of the installation, sealed with the archive key, into an S3 bucket. Secrets are never in this file: a field ending in ...Secret holds the NAME of a secret, which `secrets` says how to deliver, and a field ending in ...File holds a path (a credential the platform mounts and rotates). Telemetry is the OTEL_* environment, not configuration.

adapters.description: Names the adapter of single concerns, over the preset and the `ports` keys. The names and what each needs are in the matrix of docs/reference/sluis/adapters.md.

audit.description: The adapter for the audit sink, replacing the preset's.

adapter.description: The adapter's name, as the compatibility matrix lists it.

settings.description: The adapter's own settings (an object; the adapter refuses a key it does not know).

blobs.description: The adapter for blobs, replacing the preset's.

apiVersion.description: Which version of which document this is: the backup module's own document (docs/decisions/0071).

audit.description: The audit installation this service records to. Unset keeps the trail in the log only.

audience.description: The client whose audience the Audit page's tokens carry.

forwardedForTrustedHops.description: How many of the deployment's own proxies append to X-Forwarded-For; zero records the peer.

queryURL.description: The query service, for the console's Audit page. Its own setting: it needs no `writer`, so the page works with the `sqs` and `log` sinks. A path prefix (`https://audit.example/sluis`) is kept and the procedure path appended.

tokenFile.description: This workload's projected service-account token, presented on every call.

backup.description: What the backup module writes and where. The module reads every module's table, secrets and blobs through the `ports` and `secrets` above (its role has read access to them), and writes sealed chunks to `target`.

key.description: The key that seals each backup's data key (purpose `archive`): an alias, or {key, context}. The same as `keys.archive`; give one of them. The adapter is `keys.adapter`, or kms.

oneOf.description: An alias such as alias/audit-seal (kms) or a transit key name. An ARN or a key id is refused.

context.description: The encryption context: "default" sends {instance, purpose}; "off" sends none; an object is sent as is.

key.description: An alias such as alias/audit-seal (kms) or a transit key name. An ARN or a key id is refused.

region.description: The region of the key service, for adapter kms. Unset follows the AWS SDK's own resolution.

retention.description: Which completed backups a prune keeps. A backup is deleted when it is beyond the `keep` newest AND older than `maxAge`.

keep.description: How many of the newest completed backups are always kept.

maxAge.description: How old a backup beyond `keep` may be before it is deleted. 0s deletes it as soon as it is beyond `keep`.

role.description: Which function this document configures: `backup` (the scheduled export, the default) or `restore` (the restore function, which only an administrator or the break-glass role may invoke and whose role may write every module's table). The zip is the same; the document picks the role, and `sluis restore` selects it on the command line.

target.description: The S3 bucket of the archive. For an AWS bucket with Object Lock, enable versioning and a default retention no longer than `retention`; credentials are the function role's and are never configured here.

endpoint.description: Overrides the S3 address: LocalStack or an S3-compatible store.

kmsKey.description: A KMS key id, ARN or alias for server-side encryption of every write. Unset leaves the bucket's own default encryption.

pathStyle.description: Addresses the bucket in the path and not the host name, which LocalStack and most S3-compatible stores need.

prefix.description: A key prefix inside the bucket, put before `backup/<instance>/`.

region.description: The bucket's region. Unset follows the SDK's own resolution.

instance.description: The installation's name, bound into the default encryption context of `keys` ({instance, purpose}): stable and not secret, because a ciphertext made under it opens only with it. Unset is `release`.

keys.description: Which key serves which purpose. Keys are named by alias (KMS) or by name (transit), never by ARN or key id. See the package documentation of github.com/truvity/sluis/storage/keys.

oneOf.description: An alias such as alias/audit-seal (kms) or a transit key name. An ARN or a key id is refused.

sign.description: Token signing: the symmetric key that wraps a locally generated signing ring, or an asymmetric key that signs directly (deprecated).

oneOf.description: An alias such as alias/audit-seal (kms) or a transit key name. An ARN or a key id is refused.

keys.title: keys

platform.description: What this installation has to build on. The answers pick a preset (the decision tree in docs/concepts/sluis/ports.md), and start refuses an adapter that needs an answer that is no. Absent, the `ports` keys decide and nothing is checked against the platform.

aws.description: AWS is available: its credentials, DynamoDB, S3, SSM, KMS, SQS and EventBridge.

replicas.description: How many replicas share this installation's state. Above 1 start refuses an adapter that keeps its data in the process (`memory`).

runtime.description: Where sluis itself runs. Absent: `kubernetes` with a cluster, else `lambda` on AWS, else `process`.

ports.description: The adapters behind the storage ports (docs/concepts/sluis/ports.md).

adapter.description: `legacy` is deprecated in v1.74.0 and removed in v1.75: migrate with `sluis migrate`. It keeps state where it has always been kept: the namespace's ConfigMaps and Secrets and, when `valkey` is set, Valkey. `memory` keeps all of it in this process, which a restart loses: for a local run and the demonstration, and not with `store: kubernetes` or `valkey`.  `dynamodb` keeps the same in one DynamoDB table (`ports.dynamodb`), with the platform's credentials, and takes its Blob from `legacy` unless `ports.blob` names its own.

blob.description: Replaces the Blob port (status reports, directory snapshots) with an adapter of its own, whatever `ports.adapter` is. Absent, the Blob is `ports.adapter`'s.

adapter.description: `s3` keeps the blobs in an S3 bucket.

s3.description: Where the S3 adapter keeps its objects. Credentials are the platform's (EKS Pod Identity, IRSA, a Lambda role) and are never configured here.

bucket.description: The bucket. It must exist, with public access blocked.

credentials.description: Instead of a static document, sluis mints its own R2 credentials from a Cloudflare preset: the account's minter credential clones the preset's prototype, the credentials are renewed with a third of their lifetime left and minted again once after a 403. Exclusive with `credentialsRef`. Needs `endpoint`, the ssm secrets source, and the `cloudflare` section.

preset.description: A key of `cloudflare.presets` that has an `endpoint` (an R2 preset).

credentialsRef.description: The internal address, `internal/<kind>/<id>`, of the `s3-credentials/v1` document (`access_key_id`, `secret_access_key`) that holds the static credentials for `endpoint`, in the installation's secrets store (the ssm secrets source). Read at start and again after an answer of 403, at most once a minute. Needs `endpoint`; `region` defaults to `auto` with it. Any other address is refused. This static document is the simple way and needs nothing else: no `cloudflare` section is involved.

endpoint.description: Overrides the S3 address: LocalStack or an S3-compatible store (Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

kmsKey.description: A KMS key id, ARN or alias for server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) of every write. Absent, the bucket's default encryption applies.

pathStyle.description: Addresses the bucket in the path and not the host name, which LocalStack and most S3-compatible stores need.

prefix.description: A key prefix inside the bucket, for an installation that shares it. Names are `<prefix>/reports/<target>` and `<prefix>/snapshots/<directory>`.

region.description: The bucket's region. Absent, the SDK's own resolution (`AWS_REGION`).

dynamodb.description: The DynamoDB table of the `dynamodb` adapter: layout v4 keeps everything in one table (`table`), layout v5 one table per module (`tables`, with `secrets.layout: v5`). Each has a string partition key `pk`, a string sort key `sk` and the TTL attribute `expires`. Credentials are the platform's (EKS Pod Identity, IRSA, a Lambda role) and are never configured here; an S3-compatible `endpoint` with no such identity names a credentials document by address (`credentialsRef`), never by value.

create.description: Create the table (on-demand, TTL on `expires`) at start when it is not there, for a test or a development installation. Off, the table must exist: production uses the one the infrastructure code made, and the role needs `dynamodb:DescribeTable` on it (layout v5: the readiness probe asks, not the start).

endpoint.description: Overrides the DynamoDB address: LocalStack or DynamoDB Local.

region.description: The table's region. Absent, the SDK's own resolution (`AWS_REGION`).

table.description: Layout v4: the one table's name.

tables.description: Layout v5 (docs/decisions/0072-storage-layout-v5-module-first.md): the table of each module, by module name. A process names its own module's table and the tables of the peers it reads; a module it does not name is not opened. Needs `secrets.layout: v5`; exclusive with `table`.

backup.description: The name of the backup module's table. The library default is `sluis-<instance>-backup`.

cloudflare.description: The name of the cloudflare module's table. The library default is `sluis-<instance>-cloudflare`.

github.description: The name of the github module's table. The library default is `sluis-<instance>-github`.

google.description: The name of the google module's table. The library default is `sluis-<instance>-google`.

oidc.description: The name of the oidc module's table. The library default is `sluis-<instance>-oidc`.

slack.description: The name of the slack module's table. The library default is `sluis-<instance>-slack`.

preset.description: The adapters of a whole platform, one per concern: `server` (no AWS, no Kubernetes), `k8s-minimal`, `k8s-openbao`, `aws-serverless`, `aws-hybrid` (sluis on Lambda, a cluster for the workloads), `k8s-aws` (sluis as a pod on Kubernetes with AWS storage: DynamoDB, S3, KMS-wrapped signing; SSM secrets, or OpenBao with `adapters.secrets`). `aws-eks` is the deprecated name of `k8s-aws`. Absent, the preset the `platform` answers lead to; with neither, the `ports` keys decide. `adapters` and the `ports` keys override single concerns.

secrets.description: How the secrets this document names are delivered (truvity/policy config.md section 5). Absent is `env`.

endpoint.description: `ssm`: overrides the SSM address, for LocalStack.

grace.description: `ssm`: how long the previous value of a rotated client secret is still accepted: the document's previous revision, while the current one is younger than this (docs/decisions/0039-the-issuer-generates-confidential-client-secrets.md, the overlap).

kmsKeyId.description: `ssm`: the id, ARN or alias of the customer-managed KMS key the parameters the service itself writes (its credentials) are encrypted with. Unset, the AWS-managed `alias/aws/ssm`. The `ssm` secrets adapter's `kmsKeyId` setting; naming another there is refused.

layout.description: `ssm`: the storage layout of the installation's secrets. `v4`, the default, keeps them under `<root>/internal/config`, `<root>/internal/credentials` and `<root>/external/<kind>` (docs/decisions/0041-the-secret-contract.md). `v5` puts the module first, `<root>/internal/<module>/` and `<root>/external/<module>/` (docs/decisions/0072-storage-layout-v5-module-first.md), and needs `ports.dynamodb.tables`; the two do not mix. Layouts v3 and `transition` are gone; an installation still on one runs v1.74.x first.

refresh.description: `ssm`: how old a secret's copy may be before it is read again: a rotated secret reaches every instance within it.

region.description: `ssm`: the region. Unset follows the AWS SDK's own resolution.

root.description: `file`: the directory the secrets are mounted under. `ssm`: the installation's root, /sluis/<instance>.

source.description: `env`: the variable SLUIS_SECRET_<NAME> (the name upper-cased, every other character an underscore), for a local run. `file`: the file <root>/<name>, read on every use, so a rotated mount takes effect without a restart. `ssm`: the SecureString <root>/internal/config/<name> in AWS SSM Parameter Store, every one under the prefix read at once and again after `refresh` (root /sluis/<instance>).
